reader.requirement: At --std 85 every FUNCTION RANDOM reference that specifies argument-1, not only the first, starts a new pseudo-random sequence from that seed, whatever came before. The witness covers a later reseed by a literal and by an item; probes add the other integer argument shapes and reseeding after an unseeded start.

edition-consulted.switches: sig.IntroducedIn (85) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel: whether FUNCTION RANDOM exists at the edition

reader.edition-search: Greps of IntrinsicRenderer.cs (FloatBody 'Random' arms), CobolIntrinsics.Float.cs#Random, RandomSequence.cs and RunUnit.cs for Edition/DialectLevel/CobolVersion/DialectBehavior: none; the seeded arm always calls Random(Int128) -> RandomSequence.Restart at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: later reseeds by literal 5 and item 17; not reseeding by other argument shapes or after an unseeded first reference

probes.printed: SEED5=SAME seven times: each later reference with seed 5 (item, COMP, COMP-3, expression, integer function, subscripted item) restarts the sequence literal 5 began; SEED6=DIFFERS
probes.expected: a later reference with argument-1 starts a new sequence (§1989:A.2.35.3 AR2), equal for equal seeds (§1989:A.2.35.4 RV2)

probes.printed: UNSEEDED=ADVANCES; CALLED=CONTINUES-SEQUENCE (seed 7 after two unseeded references restarts seed 7's sequence)
probes.expected: a seeded reference after the implementor-seeded start starts a new sequence

citations.check: OK  §1989:A.2.35.3 AR2  (2.35.3 Arguments)  the text is in AR2

reader.notes: The renderer emits CobolIntrinsics.Random(seed) for every seeded reference, and that calls RunUnit.Current.Random.Restart, which replaces the one run-unit generator; nothing in the path is edition-dependent. Probe class e (files) does not apply; the run-unit probe stands in for it.

refuter.evidence: rs1.cob --std 85 (runs/rs1-002): RANDOM (5) - RANDOM (5) in one COMPUTE = 0 (SEED-SEED=ZERO); RANDOM (5) inside a MAX argument list restarts the sequence (MAX=OK); a reseed through the item W-K on each PERFORM VARYING pass makes the next unseeded value equal the 2nd value of seed 5's sequence every pass (LOOP-DONE with no LOOP-BAD); a reseed inside an IF condition (COND=OK). rs3.cob (runs/rs3-001): a reseed with 11 in a separately compiled callee RS2SUB2 restarts the caller's sequence (CALLEE-RESEED=OK). cite.py: OK §1989:A.2.35.3 AR2 the text is in AR2.
